name: Deathcall
source: Qadira, Jewel of the East pg. 15
body:
Deathcall (Su)
Source Qadira, Jewel of the East pg. 15
The witch’s presence makes death more likely for wounded foes. Creatures within 120 feet of the witch take a –1 penalty on checks to stabilize when dying. At 8th level, this penalty changes to –2, and at 16th level, it changes to –3.
